_note: Two Baidu photos of the terminal outside and in, alongside an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

hkt-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，普吉国际机场（HKT）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
hkt-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Phuket International Airport (HKT) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

hkt-baidu-1.webp.zh: 普吉国际机场航站楼屋顶的机场名称横跨整个立面，登机桥旁停着一架曼谷航空的涡桨客机。
hkt-baidu-1.webp.en: The airport's name runs across the roof of the terminal, with a Bangkok Airways turboprop at a jet bridge below.

hkt-baidu-2.webp.zh: 航站楼内的蓝色『WELCOME TO PHUKET INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT』大字，下方是柜台和通往行李厅的通道。
hkt-baidu-2.webp.en: A blue 'Welcome to Phuket International Airport' sign inside the terminal, above the counters and the way to the baggage hall.
